title: Sync disabled
symptom: On both the phone (sync master) and tablet (sync follower), the 'Disable all sync features' setting became checked overnight, stopping sync. Rebooting both devices restored sync.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer notes changes in a recent nightly related to disabling sync processing earlier in the app life-cycle if that setting is enabled, but cannot see how it could enable itself. The user denies enabling it.
fix: Rebooting both devices restored sync. No other fix is stated.
